verse.verse_2: What is the (Day) of Noise and Clamour?
verse.verse_3: And what will explain to thee what the (Day) of Noise and Clamour is?
verse.verse_4: (It is) a Day whereon men will be like moths scattered about,
verse.verse_5: And the mountains will be like carded wool.
verse.verse_6: Then, he whose balance (of good deeds) will be (found) heavy,
verse.verse_7: Will be in a life of good pleasure and satisfaction.
verse.verse_8: But he whose balance (of good deeds) will be (found) light,-
verse.verse_9: Will have his home in a (bottomless) Pit.
verse.verse_10: And what will explain to thee what this is?
